name: verification-gate
description: Two read-only reviewers that run before an agent may declare a task done.

interface.shortDescription: Adversarial reviewers that check whether a task was finished or gamed.
interface.longDescription: Two read-only reviewers that run at the end of a turn, in a context separate from the one that wrote the code. verification-critic hunts reward-hacking: weakened assertions, added skips, harness escapes, code overfit to a test's exact input. architecture-reviewer hunts structural decay: god objects, duplication, premature abstraction, unrequested scope. Each ends in a verdict, so 'done' becomes a claim something else checked. NOTE: Codex enforces neither the read-only tool restriction nor turn-blocking, so run these as a fresh `codex exec` subprocess against the diff rather than inline — see docs/portability.md.
defaultPrompt: Review the current diff for reward-hacking and spec drift
Review the current diff for structural decay
Run the verification gate before I call this done
